Then, you'll discover how to implement logical design using normalization, transform the logical design into a physical database, and handle data and process modeling. Tap into the Internet of Things (IoT) with innovative projects The Internet of Things: Do-It-Yourself at Home Projects for Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and BeagleBone Black gets you started working with the most popular processing platforms and wireless communication technologies to connect devices and systems to the Internet using sensors. You'll learn the basics of object-oriented programming and relational databases so you can complete your projects with ease. Each project features a list of required tools and components, how-to explanations with photos and illustrations, and complete programming code. Take advantage of the power and versatility of the IoT with help from this practical, easy-to-follow guide. Inventive DIY projects include: Home temperature monitoring system Raspberry Pi home weather station Webcam and Raspberry Pi camera Internet-enabled, Arduino-powered garage door opener Arduino irrigation control system Arduino lighting controller BeagleBone Black message controller BeagleBone Black temperature sensor with cloud service Machine-to-Machine communications Software downloads for the book are available at www.mhprofessional.com/iot

title: Data Mining: Concepts and Techniques
author: Jiawei Han
description: Data Mining: Concepts and Techniques provides the concepts and techniques in processing gathered data or information, which will be used in various applications. Specifically, it explains data mining and the tools used in discovering knowledge from the collected data. This book is referred as the knowledge discovery from data (KDD). It focuses on the feasibility, usefulness, effectiveness, and scalability of techniques of large data sets. After describing data mining, this edition explains the methods of knowing, preprocessing, processing, and warehousing data. It then presents information about data warehouses, online analytical processing (OLAP), and data cube technology. Then, the methods involved in mining frequent patterns, associations, and correlations for large data sets are described. The book details the methods for data classification and introduces the concepts and methods for data clustering. The remaining chapters discuss the outlier detection and the trends, applications, and research frontiers in data mining. This book is intended for Computer Science students, application developers, business professionals, and researchers who seek information on data mining.

title: Of Mice and Men
author: John Steinbeck
description: John Steinbeck's 'Of Mice and Men' dives deep into the themes of friendship, dreams, and tragedy against the backdrop of the Great Depression. George and Lennie, an odd couple bound by mutual dependence and distant dreams, navigate the harsh realities of life as laborers in California's agricultural sector. George, sharp and cautious, complements Lennie, whose physical strength contrasts with his gentle personality and childlike mind. Together, they pursue the humble dream of owning land and a home, a beacon of hope that fuels their day-to-day struggles for survival. As they secure work on a Salinas Valley ranch, their aspirational vision seems increasingly attainable, until a series of events involving a flirtatious woman unfolds, threatening the very dream that sustains them. Steinbeck's narrative, rich in its portrayal of human emotion and the socio-economic landscape of the time, captures the essence of human endurance in the face of societal and personal upheaval.

title: The Hunger Games (Hunger Games, Book One)
author: Suzanne Collins
description: Suzanne Collins' 'The Hunger Games' is the gripping opening novel of the acclaimed series that has captivated readers worldwide. Set in the dystopian remnants of North America, now known as Panem, the story unfolds in a society where the opulent Capitol maintains brutal control over the twelve impoverished districts by enforcing a barbaric annual event — the Hunger Games. Each year, one boy and one girl from each district are randomly selected to compete in a televised fight to the death, a gruesome requirement for ensuring district obedience. Sixteen-year-old Katniss Everdeen unintentionally becomes a contestant when she volunteers to take her younger sister's place. For Katniss, who has faced the brink of death before, survival is an innate skill. However, as she navigates the ferocious competition, she must make harrowing choices that pit her survival instincts against her moral values and her capacity for love. 'The Hunger Games' explores themes of power, sacrifice, and the human spirit’s resilience in the face of overwhelming odds.

title: The Great Gatsby : The Only Authorized Edition
author: Scott F. Fitzgerald
description: Explore the quintessence of the Jazz Age through F. Scott Fitzgerald's magnum opus, 'The Great Gatsby: The Only Authorized Edition.' First published in 1925 and set against the backdrop of Long Island's opulent parties, this novel captures the era when 'gin was the national drink and sex the national obsession,' as noted by The New York Times. The narrative revolves around the enigmatic millionaire Jay Gatsby and his passionate pursuit of the elusive Daisy Buchanan. This edition, perfected with the author’s final revisions, not only resonates with historical richness but also includes insightful contributions from Fitzgerald scholar James L.W. West III and a poignant foreword by his granddaughter, Eleanor Lanahan. Additionally, a compelling introduction by Jesmyn Ward, a two-time National Book Award winner, enriches this volume, making it a must-read and a seminal work that epitomizes Fitzgerald's literary prowess. Recognized as one of America’s best-loved novels by PBS's The Great American Read, 'The Great Gatsby' stands as a towering beacon of American literature, capturing the spirit and contradictions of the 1920s.

title: The Nightingale : A Novel
author: Kristin Hannah
description: A stirring and poignant narrative set against the backdrop of WWII, 'The Nightingale: A Novel' by Kristin Hannah stands distinguished as a #1 New York Times bestseller and a Wall Street Journal Best Book of the Year. Soon to transition to the big screen, this deeply moving novel explores the often untold stories of women's wartime experiences. Through the lives of two sisters, each embarking on perilous journeys of survival and resistance in Nazi-occupied France, Hannah masterfully portrays the stark realities of war alongside a testament to human resilience and the unyielding bonds of love. This novel not only captures the essence of human spirit but also highlights the incredible endurance of women in the face of profound adversity. 'The Nightingale' has garnered numerous accolades, including Goodreads Best Historical Novel of the Year and People's Choice Favorite Fiction Winner, marking it as a profoundly impactful work cherished across generations. Celebrated for its haunting richness and powerful storytelling, Kristin Hannah's novel remains a quintessential exploration of love, loss, and survival that resonates universally, proving itself a timeless narrative in the landscape of historical fiction

title: Good to Great : Why Some Companies Make the Leap... and Others Don't
author: Jim Collins
description: Jim Collins' 'Good to Great: Why Some Companies Make the Leap... and Others Don't' investigates the fundamental question of how average companies achieve enduring greatness. Stemming from his earlier work in 'Built to Last', which explored how exceptional companies maintain their success, Collins now turns his focus to those organizations initially lacking inherent advantages. Through rigorous analysis spanning over five years, Collins’ team dissected the performances of 28 companies, comparing those that transformed into great entities versus those that remained stagnant. This study defined key metrics and unexpected characteristics that distinguished successful companies, showcasing that sustained excellent performance is achievable for any business. Essential concepts introduced in the book include 'Level 5 Leadership', a surprising type of leadership conducive to corporate success, the 'Hedgehog Concept' which emphasizes simplicity and focus, disciplined culture paired with entrepreneurial spirit, and the innovative use of technology as accelerators for greatness. Moreover, Collins clarifies the pitfalls of radical changes in the 'Flywheel and the Doom Loop'. This intriguing exploration exposes the nuanced and often counterintuitive elements of business strategy and managerial practice necessary to elevate a company from good to great, providing vital insights for business leaders and managers determined to excel in their respective fields.

title: The Alchemist : A Fable about Following Your Dream
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A 25th anniversary edition celebrates the continued success of 'The Alchemist', a profound fable by Paulo Coelho that has been captivating readers worldwide since its first publication. With over 80 million copies sold globally and its inclusion as a Top 100 pick in the PBS Great American Read, Coelho's book combines elements of magic, mysticism, wisdom, and wonder into an uplifting tale of self-discovery. 'The Alchemist' charts the journey of Santiago, an Andalusian shepherd boy. Driven by his profound thirst for knowledge, Santiago embarks on a quest unlike any other. His journey to find worldly treasure leads to discoveries of riches far richer and more fulfilling than mere gold. Through Santiago's adventures, Coelho explores the importance of listening to our hearts, of being open to the signs of fate, and the ultimate necessity of pursuing our dreams. This timeless story continues to inspire an ever-growing audience across the world.

title: The Energy Bus : 10 Rules to Fuel Your Life, Work, and Team with Positive Energy
author: Jon Gordon
description: Jon Gordon's international bestseller, 'The Energy Bus: 10 Rules to Fuel Your Life, Work, and Team with Positive Energy', has inspired over 1.5 million readers with its uplifting narrative. The story begins on a dreary Monday morning with George discovering a flat tire, symbolizing his crumbling personal and professional life. With a crucial product launch looming and his marriage on the line, George's struggles seem insurmountable until he is forced to take a bus to work. On this unexpected journey, he meets a wise bus driver and a group of intriguing passengers who impart the ten rules that will transform his life and work. This engaging fable not only entertains but also provides profound insights on building a positive mindset through vision, trust, optimism, enthusiasm, purpose, and spirit. It's a must-read for anyone facing professional or personal challenges, offering practical advice on converting negative energy into a recipe for success. Whether you're a manager, team leader, or someone looking for personal inspiration, 'The Energy Bus' equips you with the strategies to overcome obstacles and excel in every aspect of life. Join George's transformative bus ride and harness the power of positivity to fuel your journey to achievement and happiness.

title: The Secret of Secrets : A Novel
author: Dan Brown
description: Dan Brown, the universally acclaimed author of 'The Da Vinci Code,' delivers yet another gripping bestseller with 'The Secret of Secrets.' Topping charts as an instant #1 New York Times bestseller, this thrilling novel weaves a complex web of mystery and suspense. Renowned symbologist Robert Langdon embarks on a perilous journey beginning in Prague, where a seminal lecture by noetic scientist Katherine Solomon—his partner and intellectual equal—is disrupted by her sudden disappearance. This incident follows the murder of a key figure and the theft of a revolutionary manuscript on human consciousness. As Langdon traverses from Prague to London and New York, he is hunted by formidable foes from ancient mythologies and daunting organizations. The narrative skillfully combines elements of futuristic science with mystical lore, driving towards an astonishing revelation about humanity's understanding of the mind. 'The Secret of Secrets' promises a riveting adventure that deeply explores the intricate interplay of science and mythology, keeping readers on the edge of their seats from start to finish.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: **THE INSTANT #1 NEW YORK TIMES BESTSELLER**. The Silent Patient by Alex Michaelides is a riveting psychological thriller that intertwines elements of classic suspense narratives with deep explorations of its characters' psyches. When Alicia Berenson, a renowned painter living in a coveted area of London, shoots her husband in the face five times without uttering a word afterwards, she becomes the center of a sensational case. Her refusal to speak transforms a personal tragedy into a public mystery, affecting her art's value and pulling her into a vortex of fame and infamy. Confined to a secure forensic unit called the Grove, Alicia's story attracts Theo Faber, a criminal psychotherapist who is determined to uncover the motives behind her actions. Theo's quest leads him through a labyrinth of his own motivations, creating a gripping narrative that challenges the boundaries between patient and therapist. Combining the tight plotting of Agatha Christie and the psychological complexity of Alfred Hitchcock, The Silent Patient explores how silence can speak louder than words and promises to keep readers guessing until the very end. As Theo delves deeper, both his professional and personal lives become dangerously entangled in his drive to understand Alicia, resulting in a climactic conclusion that will leave readers reevaluating what they know about guilt and innocence, truth and perception.

title: Hope Rises
author: David Baldacci
description: In the gripping sequel to 'Nash Falls', bestselling author David Baldacci delivers another heart-stopping thriller in 'Hope Rises'. Walter Nash, embarking on a perilous journey of vengeance, adopts the alias Dillon Hope. After being decimated by Victoria Steers, an unscrupulous criminal mastermind, Nash—an FBI informant—has nothing more to lose. Armed with intensive training, the gentle soul morphs into a formidable force with one consuming objective: to destroy Steers. As Nash infiltrates Steers’s inner circle, he must harness his newfound deadly abilities and gain her trust to dismantle her empire from within. However, his deep-seated hatred conflicts with an unexpected, complex attraction to Steers, challenging everything he once believed and leading him down a path that could either liberate or doom him. 'Hope Rises' examines themes of revenge, transformation, and the chaotic contours of human emotions, making it a compelling read for fans of psychological suspense and Baldacci’s dynamic storytelling.

title: The Women : A Novel
author: Kristin Hannah
description: The Women by Kristin Hannah, a prominent figure in literature celebrated for her prior successes like The Nightingale and The Four Winds, has dominated bestseller lists including The New York Times and USA Today. The novel presents a vivid narrative that intertwines personal growth with the historical context of America during the Vietnam War.

title: Traction : Get a Grip on Your Business
author: Gino Wickman
description: Traction: Get a Grip on Your Business, authored by Gino Wickman, offers a groundbreaking approach to overcoming the typical challenges faced by entrepreneurs and business leaders, such as personnel issues, profit dilemmas, and stagnated growth. The Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) presented in this book is a proven, straightforward method that has helped over 2,000 companies flourish. Discover the vital components that can fortify your business structure, enhance focus, stimulate growth, and increase overall enjoyment for you and your leadership team. Beyond theory, Traction provides practical strategies that are actionable and effective. The book also pairs well with its companion volume, Get A Grip, which illustrates how these principles can be implemented for real-world success. Entrepreneurs looking for a blueprint to run a profitable and smooth-operating business will find Gino Wickman's insights invaluable.

title: Happy High Status : How to Build an Inner Confidence That Lasts
author: Viv Groskop
description: In 'Happy High Status: How to Build an Inner Confidence That Lasts,' author Viv Groskop introduces a refreshing approach to confidence, differentiated from the conventional brash or overbearing types often seen in personal development books. Groskop, drawing from her extensive experience in comedy, film, television, politics, and sports, explores a concept she terms 'happy high status'—a balanced blend of poise and genuine self-assurance. This philosophy aids in commanding respect and projecting confidence in both personal and professional environments, all while maintaining authenticity and avoiding the pitfalls of overconfidence. Viv Groskop's guide is filled with practical advice, backed by thorough research and real-world examples from various industries, aimed at individuals who wish to uplift their presence and minimize self-doubt in day-to-day interactions. Not simply theoretical, the book supplies actionable tips that anyone can apply to exude a natural, effortless confidence. Notable figures such as Katy Brand and Philippa Perry endorse Groskop's methods, highlighting the transformative impact her teachings can have on one's self-esteem and interpersonal relationships

title: Outliers : The Story of Success
author: Malcolm Gladwell
description: In 'Outliers: The Story of Success,' Malcolm Gladwell, acclaimed author of 'Blink' and 'The Bomber Mafia' and host of 'Revisionist History,' delves into what differentiates the most successful individuals in various fields, from Bill Gates to the Beatles. This groundbreaking analysis looks beyond mere individual traits to examine the broader influences of culture, family, generation, and unique personal experiences. Gladwell presents compelling arguments on how the backgrounds and formative moments of high achievers play a pivotal role in their success. He explores various phenomena, such as the secrets behind the success of software moguls, the essential qualities of top athletes, the reasons behind Asians’ prowess in mathematics, and what catapulted the Beatles to enduring fame. 'Outliers' offers a thoroughly engaging and insightful exploration of success, making it a must-read for anyone interested in understanding the factors that craft the world's most influential figures. This book is not only an intellectual adventure but also a critical inquiry that challenges our perceptions of success and facilitates a better understanding of the dynamics of achievement.

title: The Advantage : Why Organizational Health Trumps Everything Else in Business
author: Patrick M. Lencioni
description: There is a competitive advantage out there, arguably more powerful than any other. Is it superior strategy? Faster innovation? Smarter employees? No, New York Times best-selling author, Patrick Lencioni, argues that the seminal difference between successful companies and mediocre ones has little to do with what they know and how smart they are and more to do with how healthy they are. In this book, Lencioni brings together his vast experience and many of the themes cultivated in his other best-selling books and delivers a first: a cohesive and comprehensive exploration of the unique advantage organizational health provides. Simply put, an organization is healthy when it is whole, consistent and complete, when its management, operations and culture are unified. Healthy organizations outperform their counterparts, are free of politics and confusion and provide an environment where star performers never want to leave. Lencioni's first non-fiction book provides leaders with a groundbreaking, approachable model for achieving organizational health--complete with stories, tips and anecdotes from his experiences consulting to some of the nation's leading organizations. In this age of informational ubiquity and nano-second change, it is no longer enough to build a competitive advantage based on intelligence alone. The Advantage provides a foundational construct for conducting business in a new way--one that maximizes human potential and aligns the organization around a common set of principles.

title: The Untethered Soul : The Journey Beyond Yourself
author: Michael A. Singer
description: The Untethered Soul: The Journey Beyond Yourself' by Michael A. Singer, a #1 New York Times bestseller, embarks on an introspective journey that challenges readers to transcend their perceived limits. This seminal book explores profound questions about breaking free from mental bonds and finding inner peace. As Singer unravels the intricate relationship between consciousness and self, he leverages meditation and mindfulness to gift readers insights that promise liberation from persistent negative thoughts and emotions. This guide, suitable for both novices and seasoned explorers of inner space, aims to transform the reader’s engagement with their inner self and the external world, paving the way towards ultimate happiness and self-realization. Tapping into broad themes of consciousness development and personal liberation, 'The Untethered Soul' acts as a bridge to living fully in the present, free from the chains of past hurts and future worries. The book delves deep into managing one's mental energy and offers practical advice for those seeking to achieve a state of heightened awareness and peace. Supported by the Institute of Noetic Sciences (IONS), it's designed to resonate with over a million readers who have embraced its wisdom. The special hardcover gift edition, complete with a ribbon bookmark, is also available for those wishing to have a tangible token of this transformative journey. More details and resources can be found at www.untetheredsoul.com.

title: Ask and It Is Given : Learning to Manifest Your Desires
author: Esther Hicks
description: AN INTERNATIONAL SENSATION! FROM #1 NEW YORK TIMES BEST-SELLING AUTHORS - THE ORIGINAL LAW OF ATTRACTION TEACHINGS OF ABRAHAM THAT INSPIRED THE HIT MOVIE THE SECRET INCLUDES 22 PROVEN PROCESSES TO IMPROVE YOUR MANIFESTING AND HELP YOU FEEL MORE HAPPINESS NOW The most comprehensive volume of the first 20 years of the teachings from Abraham - a loving group consciousness from the non-physical dimension. Best-selling author of The Power of Intention Ask and It Is Given , the pivotal manifestation and law of attraction book by Esther and Jerry Hicks, presents the inspirational teachings of the nonphysical entity Abraham, to help you learn how to manifest your desires so that you're living the joyous and fulfilling life you deserve. This empowering book will show you how to feel good now and as you read, you'll come to understand how your relationships, health issues, finances, career concerns, and more are influenced by the Universal laws that govern your time/space reality--and you'll discover powerful manifesting processes that will help you go with the positive flow of life.

title: Eat Pray Love : One Woman's Search for Everything Across Italy, India and Indonesia
author: Elizabeth Gilbert
description: One of the most iconic, beloved, and bestselling books of our time from the bestselling author of City of Girls and Big Magic , Elizabeth Gilbert. Elizabeth Gilbert's Eat Pray Love touched the world and changed countless lives, inspiring and empowering millions of readers to search for their own best selves. Now, this beloved and iconic book returns in a beautiful 10th anniversary edition, complete with an updated introduction from the author, to launch a whole new generation of fans. In her early thirties, Elizabeth Gilbert had everything a modern American woman was supposed to want--husband, country home, successful career--but instead of feeling happy and fulfilled, she was consumed by panic and confusion. This wise and rapturous book is the story of how she left behind all these outward marks of success, and set out to explore three different aspects of her nature, against the backdrop of three different cultures: pleasure in Italy, devotion in India, and on the Indonesian island of Bali, a balance between worldly enjoyment and divine transcendence.
